description: SeleneSync is a team building an interactive CLPS Lunar Mission Browser to compare lunar landing sites, sunlight availability, and Earth communication windows. Led by Roman Farooq, a software engineer with Python, React/Next.js, AI, and satellite-operations experience, we welcome teammates interested in coding, scientific computing, space science, data visualization, UI/UX, and research. Join us to turn space data into a practical mission-planning tool!
